name: Bash config directories
description: Sources every bashrc_*.sh from ~/.bashrc, and every profile_*.sh from the login profile, out of two fixed container directories: dirs/user (empty, yours to mount or fill) and dirs/project (a symlink a create-time hook points at your workspace). The blocks appended to those two files are a static two lines naming a fixed path, so nothing ever rewrites them; both directories are read fresh by every shell, so a file added after the build applies to the next shell with no rebuild.

projectDir.description: Workspace-relative directory that dirs/project is linked to, resolved at create time. An absolute value is linked as-is. Empty creates no symlink at all.
